conclusion: The clean render decodes every frame. Each degradation has a different failure mode: blur mixes triangle interiors, noise perturbs the per-cell threshold, JPEG creates block artefacts, ambient/brightness shift the histogram, perspective stresses fiducial detection, and vignetting reduces corner contrast. The per-parameter tables show where the CRC success rate falls; these are SIMULATED observations, not physical camera results.
